notes.title: 30 New Card Upgrades
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys![/p][p]I'm adding 30 new card upgrades from the Full version of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Some of these will allow you to regain health ❤️‍🩹 while others will increase your damage 🗡️ output by 2x / 4x!!! Of course, nothing in this world is free, so you might have to deal with some nasty side effects 😰[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a sneak peek of the new Cards:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44977891/6713e229dd132d9ae6ef86191e7844601cefad05.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Apart from that, there are a couple new dialogues from the main game, balance changes and a couple other changes![/p][p][/p][h1]Important information ‼️‼️[/h1][list][*][p]All should work fine, but it's been a long time since I updated the prologue version, so please let me know if something is not working as expected. 📝[/p][/*][*][p]I moved the game to a newer version of the game engine, and there were a couple report of the game crashing. If that happens to you, could you please reach out to me on Discord or directly here on Steam? Please, please, please. 🙏 🙏 🙏[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: The wait is OVER! Hollow Survivors has officially launched🏰🔥
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The wait is OVER! Hollow Survivors has officially launched[/b], and the battle for the Tower begins NOW! 🏰🔥[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/

Get ready to hack & slash your way through endless waves of enemies, uncover hidden secrets, and face the powerful Soulbinders who threaten to destroy everything. With every floor you conquer, the challenge grows – will you have the strength to reach the top?

🔥 [b]Master the rogue-like dungeon crawler experience[/b] – fast-paced combat, intense action, and endless replayability!
 🗡️ [b]Upgrade your gear and skills[/b] – become stronger with each battle and craft the perfect build!
 👹 [b]Face hordes of relentless enemies[/b] – adapt, strategize, and survive against brutal challenges!
 🏆 [b]Uncover the Tower’s dark secrets[/b] – the deeper you go, the closer you get to the truth!

The Tower is calling… Are you ready to fight your way to the top and prove yourself as the ultimate survivor?

It's been a long journey guys, and I'm so excited we're at the finish line... or perhaps this is just the beginning? I wanted to thank all of you for being here with me and supporting me. It really does mean a lot to me. [b]Here's a couple more words from me:[/b]

[previewyoutube=Bs8nPmYpPnc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]⚔️ Play now and begin your journey! ⚔️[/b][/h3]

notes.title: FULL VERSION | 🔥 BIG ANNOUNCEMENT! 🔥
notes.notes:
[b][h2]🏰 The time to conquer the tower has come! 🏰[/h2][/b]

After countless battles, hundreds of upgrades, and thousands of defeated enemies, the moment you've been waiting for is finally here! ⚔️💥 O[b]n April 10th, Hollow Survivor is leveling up – THE FULL VERSION is launching![/b] 🌟🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285940/Hollow_Survivors/

[h3]🔺 What’s waiting for you? 🔺[/h3]
 🗡️ More floors, more challenges! – New locations and even deadlier enemies ready to tear you apart pixel by pixel! 👾💀
 💰 Even more gear! – Find, buy, and upgrade your equipment to survive the ever-growing dangers. A basic sword? Pff… Time to wield something legendary! ⚒️🔥
 💀 Hordes of monsters! – New enemy types, relentless attacks, and bosses that will push your skills to the limit! 🕷️🐉
 🌟 A full-fledged campaign! – Can you climb to the very top?

[h3]🔜 Mark your calendars – [b]APRIL 10TH[/b], the real challenge begins! 🚀[/h3]

 Do you have what it takes to become a legend in Hollow Survivor? ⚔️🏆
